title: RecipeTin's Hokkien Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp canola oil, 2 cloves garlic minced
8 green onion stems, 1 red capsicum, 3 cups cabbage
Sauce: 2 tbsp light soy, 1.5 tbsp dark soy, 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 0.125 tsp white pepper
Garnish: white sesame seeds, sliced green onion
steps: Mix sauce ingredients in a bowl. Toss chicken with 1.5 tbsp of sauce and marinate for 10 minutes.
Prepare noodles per packet directions, drain, and rinse briefly under cold tap water.
Heat oil in a large 30cm non-stick pan on high heat. Add chicken and toss for 1 minute.
Add garlic and white green onion parts; toss for 1 minute until chicken surface seals.
Add capsicum and cabbage; toss for 2 minutes until cabbage wilts.
Add remaining sauce, noodles, and green onion tops. Toss for 2 minutes and serve immediately.
